hierarchy_rules: Overlines: uppercase text-xs tracking-widest font-bold text-gray-500

surfaces_and_layout.strategy: Soft Neo-Brutalism. Use soft pastel colors combined with sharp, distinct borders to prevent the UI from feeling purely childish, maintaining a functional 'dashboard' structure.
surfaces_and_layout.cards: bg-white border-2 border-gray-900 rounded-xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(31,41,55,1)] transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(31,41,55,1)]
surfaces_and_layout.inputs: bg-white border-2 border-gray-300 focus:border-gray-900 focus:ring-0 rounded-lg shadow-sm focus:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(31,41,55,1)] transition-all

buttons.primary: bg-[#B9FBC0] text-gray-900 border-2 border-gray-900 rounded-lg font-bold shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(31,41,55,1)] hover:bg-[#90DBF4] hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(31,41,55,1)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-900 border-2 border-gray-900 rounded-lg font-semibold shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(31,41,55,1)] hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all

surfaces_and_layout.grid: Bento Control Room grid. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-6 with gap-6. Calendar/Weekend Planner should span 4 cols, Shopping List spans 2 cols.

components.navigation: Sticky top nav with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80) or a solid side-nav on desktop with hard border right.
components.calendar: Shadcn calendar, customized to visually highlight weekends (Sat/Sun) with a different pastel background (e.g., bg-[#FBF8CC]/50).
components.shopping_list: Checkable list items. When checked, apply line-through and text-gray-400. Include a quick-add input with auto-suggest dropdown. Group items by supermarket tags.
components.barcode_scanner: Provide a clean modal/dialog for camera barcode scanning, plus a manual entry fallback text input.
components.notes: Masonry grid or simple list of sticky-note style cards using the varied pastel accent colors.
components.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Set stroke width to 2.5 for a chunkier, friendlier feel.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Elements lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and shadows extend to create tactile depth.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use spring-like transitions (duration-200 ease-out) for satisfying micro-interactions.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Always ensure focus states have a high-contrast ring or hard border. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

testing.requirements: ALL interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Examples: 'login-google-button', 'add-child-btn', 'calendar-weekend-view', 'shopping-list-add-input', 'scan-barcode-btn'.

image_urls.description: Joyful family of four smiling together at the kitchen counter during breakfast time.
Couple in kitchen, man using tablet, woman preparing food.
Organized grocery store aisle with fresh produce.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Outfit and Figtree.
Follow the soft neo-brutalist theme strictly: use the pastel colors for backgrounds/accents, but use strong 2px dark borders (#1F2937) and sharp shadows for containers.
Implement Google SSO using the standard Emergent-managed Google Auth flow.
For the shopping list, implement a tag system for Australian supermarkets (Coles, Woolworths, Aldi, IGA, Foodworks) using the colors defined in colors.supermarket_tags.
Build the dashboard using a Bento grid layout, prioritizing the Calendar and Shopping List.
Implement a barcode scanning capability (mock the camera logic if actual API is unavailable, but build the UI for it).
Ensure ALL interactive elements contain 'data-testid' attributes.
